name: virat-design
why: Purpose-built for exactly this output family: minimal design methodology for social posts, carousels, stories (1080x1920), posters, thumbnails, banners and covers; fixed principles with brand-adaptable tokens and a QA checklist.
caveats: Low star count; chosen for fit, not fame. The 99k-star alternative (Leonxlnx/taste-skill) is a frontend landing-page skill, not static social graphics.
Its Virat default palette (royal blue) is overridden by the maalsadiqeen brand tokens: paper/green/gold only.
It is explicitly for static visuals, not video motion; use it for frames, covers and carousels.
